mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, name_zh, symbol, decimal_places, created_at, updated_at FROM currency ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency (code, name, name_zh, symbol, decimal_places, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{nameZh}, #{symbol}, #{decimalPlaces}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE currency SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, name_zh = #{nameZh}, symbol = #{symbol}, decimal_places = #{decimalPlaces}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
